name: com.unity.ide.qoder
description: Code editor integration for supporting Qoder as code editor for Unity. Adds support for generating csproj files for IntelliSense, auto discovery of installations, debugging configuration, and more.

_upm.changelog:
v1.1.0:
- Fixed GetRealPath platform protection for Windows
- Fixed package name in FileUtility.GetPackageAssetFullPath
- Fixed duplicate condition in FindRunningQoderWithSolution
- Added .slnx support in VisualStudioCodeInstallation
- Added exception logging in CreateExtraFiles methods
- Enhanced recommended extensions list
- Added GeneratorFactory for SDK/Legacy style switching
- Updated C# language support to 13.0
- Enhanced settings.json with file associations and nesting
- Improved extension path discovery
- Added comprehensive debugging configurations
